claims: Any trove link not requested for 5 minutes gets an "unavailable" preview on its next unfurl, even when Hasura is healthy — `trove-og-data.ts:273-274`: after an idle gap unstable_cache hands back the old entry and line 274 sees it is older than 5 minutes and returns `null` instead of fetching fresh data

Missing test: the test mocks `unstable_cache` as a plain pass-through (`__tests__/trove-og-data.test.ts:12-25`), so the stale-entry path never runs; the test at lines 227-239 only checks the age helper `troveOgDataIsFresh`, not what the metadata path does with an old entry

Cached "not found" results have no timestamp, so the fix won't age-check them — `trove-og-data.ts:212-214, 274`: a trove not indexed yet or a mismatched symbol is cached as bare `null`, and the first request after an idle gap still gets an old `null`
The card says "temporarily" for troves that will never exist — `_og/trove-og-card.tsx:397`: that text shows for any `null`, including a wrong symbol or trove ID
`shortTroveId` is copied into `page.tsx:48`, identical to `_og/trove-og-card.tsx:115`; importing it keeps the page title and the card in sync

judge_reasoning.3882086206: The review's only duplication note is about shortTroveId being copied between page.tsx and trove-og-card.tsx. It never mentions icrTone duplicating icrTextClass's threshold math.
judge_reasoning.3882119274: The review never raises the problem of event-time icrBps being shown on the OG card as a live health signal.
judge_reasoning.3882119284: The review's cache finding is the opposite problem: entries older than 5 minutes return null and show 'unavailable'. It does not flag the image response's max-age and stale-while-revalidate stacking on top of a nearly 5-minute-old data snapshot, which lets card data reach about 11 minutes old.

1.why: trove-og-data.ts:254-274: unstable_cache has revalidate 60, which serves the stale entry while it revalidates in the background. After more than 5 idle minutes, troveOgDataIsFresh fails on line 274 and the function returns null, so that unfurl shows the unavailable card even when Hasura is healthy. This is a different issue from the known combined-age item at opengraph-image.tsx:54.

2.why: The test mock at trove-og-data.test.ts:12-25 returns fn unchanged, so the cache never replays an old entry. The test at 227-239 calls only troveOgDataIsFresh with synthetic data and never runs fetchTroveOgDataForMetadata against an old entry.

3.why: It is true that nulls from lines 212-214 carry no fetchedAtMs. But line 274 turns any entry that fails the age check into null anyway, so age-checking a cached null would give the same null. The missing timestamp changes nothing; the real cause is the stale-while-revalidate behavior in claim 1.

4.why: _og/trove-og-card.tsx:387-397 shows 'The indexed snapshot is temporarily unavailable.' whenever data === null. fetchTroveOgDataForMetadata also returns null for a symbol with no matching collateral and for a missing trove row (lines 203, 212), so troves that will never exist are called temporarily unavailable.

5.why: This diff adds shortTroveId at page.tsx:48-50. It is character-for-character the same as the exported shortTroveId at _og/trove-og-card.tsx:115-117, which opengraph-image.tsx already imports. The social title and the card's short ID can therefore drift apart.
